Secondly, the ROA (Return On Assets) at 6.74% [E7] surpasses the sector benchmark of 1.8%, indicating efficient asset utilization and strong profitability. This further supports the argument that Everlon Financials is a better investment option than its peers. Thirdly, while the ROE (Return On Equity) at 3.89% [E8] falls below the sector benchmark of 4.93%, this can be mitigated by considering the company's strong sales growth over the last three years at 46% [E15].
